purpose: Verify system opens dedicated course workspace when authorized user selects a course
preconditions: Course CS101 exists; user is enrolled as an authorized student in CS101
action_or_input: Authorized student requests to open course workspace for CS101
expected_result: Course workspace for CS101 is opened and returned successfully

purpose: Verify system displays course syllabus, schedule, instructor(s), and TA(s) on course home page
preconditions: Course CS101 exists with configured syllabus, schedule, assigned instructor and TA; user is enrolled
action_or_input: User views course home page for CS101
expected_result: Course home details display syllabus, schedule, instructor list, and TA roster

purpose: Verify system restricts course workspace access to users enrolled in, assigned to, or linked to the course
preconditions: Course CS101 exists; user is not enrolled in, assigned to, or linked to CS101
action_or_input: Unenrolled user attempts to access course workspace for CS101
expected_result: Access is restricted and denied (404 Not Found / access error preventing leakage)

purpose: Verify Faculty can configure course workspace for an assigned course
preconditions: Course CS101 exists; Faculty member is assigned as instructor to CS101
action_or_input: Assigned Faculty updates course workspace configuration (syllabus, schedule, description)
expected_result: Workspace configuration is updated successfully

purpose: Verify Faculty can publish and edit course details for an assigned course workspace
preconditions: Course CS101 exists; Faculty is assigned to CS101; course details were previously published
action_or_input: Assigned Faculty edits course title and syllabus and publishes changes
expected_result: Updated course details are persisted and published

purpose: Verify Faculty can add course materials as files, links, or notes
preconditions: Course CS101 exists; Faculty is assigned to CS101
action_or_input: Faculty creates three materials: one file material, one link material, and one lecture note material
expected_result: All three material types (file, link, note) are accepted and created in the course

purpose: Verify Faculty can organize course materials into modules or weekly sections
preconditions: Course CS101 exists; Faculty is assigned to CS101
action_or_input: Faculty adds material with module/weekly section organization specified
expected_result: Material is stored and categorized under the designated module or weekly section

purpose: Verify Faculty can configure a future release date for course material
preconditions: Course CS101 exists; Faculty is assigned to CS101
action_or_input: Faculty creates course material with release_at set to a future timestamp
expected_result: Material is created with scheduled release status and future timestamp

purpose: Verify scheduled material is published/available to authorized users when release time is reached
preconditions: Course CS101 has scheduled material whose release timestamp has arrived/passed
action_or_input: System processes scheduled releases at or after release time
expected_result: Material transitions to published state and becomes available to authorized users

purpose: Verify Student can view published course materials for registered course in read-only form
preconditions: Course CS101 has published materials; student is enrolled in CS101
action_or_input: Enrolled student requests course materials list for CS101
expected_result: Published materials are returned in read-only format; draft or unreleased materials are not visible

purpose: Verify TA can view published course materials for assigned course in read-only form
preconditions: Course CS101 has published materials; TA is assigned to CS101
action_or_input: Assigned TA requests course materials list for CS101
expected_result: Published materials are returned in read-only format for TA

purpose: Verify Observer can view published course materials for linked course in read-only form
preconditions: Course CS101 has published materials; user is linked as Observer to CS101
action_or_input: Observer requests course materials list for CS101
expected_result: Published materials are returned in read-only format for Observer

purpose: Verify Faculty can post a course-wide announcement for an assigned course
preconditions: Course CS101 exists; Faculty is assigned to CS101
action_or_input: Faculty posts announcement with valid title and content
expected_result: Announcement is created and posted to the course stream

purpose: Verify TA can post announcement only when permitted, and unpermitted TA is prevented from posting
preconditions: Course CS101 exists; TA is assigned to CS101 without posting permission
action_or_input: Unpermitted TA attempts to post an announcement to CS101
expected_result: Announcement posting attempt is denied with permission error

purpose: Verify system timestamps each posted course announcement
preconditions: Course CS101 exists; Faculty is assigned to CS101
action_or_input: Faculty posts an announcement to CS101
expected_result: Created announcement records a valid creation timestamp

purpose: Verify posted announcement is visible to all users enrolled in or linked to the course
preconditions: Announcement posted in CS101; Faculty, Student, TA, and Observer are members of CS101
action_or_input: Each member role requests announcements for CS101
expected_result: The announcement is visible to all enrolled or linked members

purpose: Verify Faculty can create an assignment for an assigned course
preconditions: Course CS101 exists; Faculty is assigned to CS101
action_or_input: Faculty creates an assignment with valid parameters
expected_result: Assignment is created successfully in CS101

purpose: Verify system captures assignment due date, instructions, submission type, and points possible
preconditions: Course CS101 exists; Faculty is assigned to CS101
action_or_input: Faculty creates assignment with due_date, instructions, submission_type file, and points_possible 100
expected_result: All configuration fields (due_date, instructions, submission_type, points_possible) are captured and stored

purpose: Verify Faculty can edit an existing assignment
preconditions: Assignment A1 exists in CS101; Faculty is assigned to CS101
action_or_input: Faculty updates assignment instructions and points possible
expected_result: Assignment details are updated with the new configuration

purpose: Verify assignment remains in Draft state until Faculty publishes it
preconditions: Faculty creates assignment without immediate publication
action_or_input: Inspect assignment status immediately after creation
expected_result: Assignment status is Draft; assignment is not published

purpose: Verify Faculty can publish an assignment
preconditions: Draft assignment A1 exists in CS101; Faculty is assigned to CS101
action_or_input: Faculty initiates publish action on assignment A1
expected_result: Assignment status transitions from Draft to Published

purpose: Verify published assignment with future release date is withheld from Students until release time
preconditions: Assignment A1 is published with release_at set to future date; student is enrolled in CS101
action_or_input: Enrolled student queries assignments for CS101 before release date
expected_result: Assignment A1 is withheld and omitted from student view

purpose: Verify scheduled assignment becomes available to authorized Students when release time is reached
preconditions: Assignment A1 was scheduled with release_at; current time reaches or passes release_at
action_or_input: System releases assignment or student queries assignments at/after release time
expected_result: Assignment A1 becomes visible and accessible to authorized students

purpose: Verify Student can view and download released assignment for registered course
preconditions: Assignment A1 is released and has attachment file; student is enrolled in CS101
action_or_input: Student retrieves assignment details and downloads attachment
expected_result: Assignment details and attachment file are successfully retrieved

purpose: Verify Student can submit assignment work according to configured submission type (file, text, link)
preconditions: Released assignment configured for file submission; student enrolled in CS101
action_or_input: Student submits matching file artifact for assignment
expected_result: Submission is accepted and recorded with the file artifact

purpose: Verify system accepts and records Student submission made before due date
preconditions: Released assignment with future due date; student enrolled in CS101
action_or_input: Student submits work prior to the due date
expected_result: Submission is accepted, recorded as on-time (status submitted, is_late=False)

purpose: Verify Student can view Student own submission history for an assignment
preconditions: Student S1 has submitted work for assignment A1; Student S2 also submitted work
action_or_input: Student S1 queries submission history for assignment A1
expected_result: Only Student S1 own submission records are returned; S2 records are omitted

purpose: Verify system shows Student own submission status as submitted, late, or missing
preconditions: Assignment A1 exists; student S1 submitted on time; student S2 submitted after due date; student S3 has not submitted and deadline passed
action_or_input: Query submission status for S1, S2, and S3
expected_result: Status is displayed accurately (e.g. submitted, late, missing) reflecting submission timing

purpose: Verify Faculty can grade an individual Student submission by entering points and feedback
preconditions: Student submission exists for assignment A1; Faculty is assigned to CS101
action_or_input: Faculty grades submission with points=85 and feedback text
expected_result: Grade score and feedback are saved successfully

purpose: Verify TA can grade an individual Student submission for assigned course with points and feedback
preconditions: Student submission exists in CS101; TA is assigned to CS101
action_or_input: TA grades submission with points=78 and feedback text
expected_result: Grade score and feedback entered by TA are saved successfully

purpose: Verify system records identity of Faculty member or TA who performs grading action
preconditions: Submission exists; grader (Faculty or TA) performs grading
action_or_input: Grader submits grade evaluation for student submission
expected_result: Saved grade record contains graded_by / grader user identifier matching the actor

purpose: Verify grade and feedback remain in Draft state until release
preconditions: Grader evaluates submission and saves grade without immediate release
action_or_input: Inspect status of saved grade record
expected_result: Grade status is Draft / unreleased

purpose: Verify system prevents Student from viewing grade or feedback before release
preconditions: Submission has grade in Draft state; student is the submitter
action_or_input: Student queries submission or grade details before release
expected_result: Draft grade score and feedback are withheld and hidden from student view

purpose: Verify Faculty can release draft grades and feedback to Students
preconditions: Draft grades exist for assignment submissions; Faculty is assigned to CS101
action_or_input: Faculty initiates grade release for assignment submissions
expected_result: Grades transition to Released state and become available to students

purpose: Verify Student can view own grade and feedback after release
preconditions: Student submission grade is in Released state; student is the submitter
action_or_input: Student views grade and feedback for the submission
expected_result: Released score and instructor feedback are visible to the student

purpose: Verify released grade and feedback are presented to Student in read-only form
preconditions: Student views released grade
action_or_input: Student attempts to modify grade or views representation
expected_result: Grade is read-only; student cannot edit or alter score or feedback

purpose: Verify system records who made the change when a released grade is changed
preconditions: Released grade exists in CS101; Faculty updates score/feedback
action_or_input: Faculty updates previously released grade
expected_result: System updates grade and logs identity of user who modified the grade

purpose: Verify system records when change was made when a released grade is changed
preconditions: Released grade exists in CS101; Faculty updates score/feedback
action_or_input: Faculty updates previously released grade
expected_result: System updates grade and logs audit timestamp of the modification

purpose: Verify TA can view course details, published materials, and announcements for assigned course
preconditions: Course CS101 has published materials and announcements; TA is assigned to CS101
action_or_input: TA queries course workspace, materials, and announcements
expected_result: TA successfully views workspace details, published materials, and announcements

purpose: Verify TA can view Student submissions for assigned course
preconditions: Submissions exist for assignment in CS101; TA is assigned to CS101
action_or_input: TA queries student submissions for assignment in CS101
expected_result: TA successfully retrieves list and details of student submissions

purpose: Verify TA is prevented from creating or editing assignments
preconditions: Course CS101 exists; TA is assigned to CS101
action_or_input: TA attempts to create or edit an assignment in CS101
expected_result: Operation is denied with permission error (403 Forbidden / PermissionDenied)

purpose: Verify TA is prevented from creating or editing course materials
preconditions: Course CS101 exists; TA is assigned to CS101
action_or_input: TA attempts to create, update, or delete course materials in CS101
expected_result: Operation is denied with permission error (403 Forbidden / PermissionDenied)

purpose: Verify TA is prevented from modifying course structure
preconditions: Course CS101 exists; TA is assigned to CS101
action_or_input: TA attempts to modify course workspace configuration or structure in CS101
expected_result: Operation is denied with permission error (403 Forbidden / PermissionDenied)

purpose: Verify Observer can view course details, published materials, and announcements in read-only form
preconditions: Course CS101 has published materials and announcements; user is linked as Observer to CS101
action_or_input: Observer views workspace details, published materials, and announcements
expected_result: Observer retrieves course overview, published materials, and announcements in read-only format

purpose: Verify Observer is prevented from viewing individual Student submissions
preconditions: Student submissions exist in CS101; user is linked as Observer to CS101
action_or_input: Observer attempts to view or list student submissions in CS101
expected_result: Access is denied (403 Forbidden / PermissionDenied)

purpose: Verify Observer is prevented from viewing grades or any Student-specific data
preconditions: Grades and student submissions exist in CS101; user is linked as Observer to CS101
action_or_input: Observer attempts to access grades or student performance data
expected_result: Access is denied (403 Forbidden / PermissionDenied)

purpose: Verify Observer is prevented from performing write actions anywhere in LMS Course Management
preconditions: Course CS101 exists; user is linked as Observer to CS101
action_or_input: Observer attempts write operations (create announcement, create material, modify course)
expected_result: Write operations are strictly denied (403 Forbidden / PermissionDenied)
